digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler live integration against Jira Data Center
propositions: The reconciler must prove bidirectional data sync against a real Jira Data Center instance using a production-copy store, not an empty one, to surface field-mapping and ordering defects.
Isolation of the test store from production must be enforced at the git-remote level (no origin remote exists) and verified by test assertion, not assumed by configuration.

The production ticket store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* artifacts and bindings before reconciliation, and the scrub completeness must be verified structurally by enumerating the copied tree.

A DC-created issue must appear in the local store after an inbound pass, and a local ticket edit must appear on the DC instance after an outbound pass, each asserted individually against named oracles rather than converged totals.

Pagination must be proven by observing the server's effective page size, seeding at least 2*observed+1 issues to force three pages, and asserting full recovery of seeded issues from the inbound fetch.

Inbound assignee mutations must positively mint a jira-family identity in the registry across the pass, not merely store the raw username value, asserted via the identity resolver before and after the pass.
